relationships.status: Confirmed
relationships.evidence: PACT technical fields record cross-sectoral standards including the GHG Protocol Product Standard.
relationships.constraints: PACT and GHGP requirements are version-specific.
relationships.validation_question: Capture method version in every footprint.

relationships.status: Confirmed
relationships.evidence: PACT technical fields include ISO 14067 among permitted cross-sectoral standards.
relationships.constraints: Data exchange conformance does not prove calculation conformance.
relationships.validation_question: Retain assurance evidence with each footprint.

relationships.status: Confirmed
relationships.evidence: PACT explicitly states that Methodology v3 is the foundation for Technical Specifications v3.
relationships.constraints: Version pairs must remain compatible.
relationships.validation_question: Record methodology/specification pair.

relationships.status: Documented relationship; detailed mapping needed
relationships.evidence: Both support structured supplier PCF exchange and Catena-X participates in broader PCF interoperability work.
relationships.constraints: Fields and lifecycle semantics may differ.
relationships.validation_question: Maintain a versioned crosswalk.

relationships.status: Potential
relationships.evidence: Makersite produces PCFs that could be exchanged through PACT-compatible structures.
relationships.constraints: Public conformance was not verified.
relationships.validation_question: Test an exported PCF against the current schema.
